qa.user_verbatim_complaint: 彻底修复实现我的spec目标 — thoroughly fix the prior /redev cycle 20260518-101127's spec goal (unified viewer+editor, life-ai backward compatible, all prior travel plans except Yunnan unchanged). Prior cycle declared CLOSE: YES but the visual layer was completely broken; user reported 拖了没反应.
qa.overall_assessment: REJECT. The BA ticket is largely thoughtful (12 codex findings logged, R1-R5 correctly target the L3 data-transformation gap, ACs are mostly pixel-layer), but contains 9 concrete defects that would let dev ship a partially-broken fix or let QA pass a fix that still fails the user-facing visual update. Three of the defects are fatal: (a) AC3 references option_ids that do not exist in the fixture (afternoon_activity-2-1) and would also be rejected by _isCompatible even if they existed; (b) AC9 cover-image flow is unverifiable in the entire 9-day Yunnan dataset; (c) R1 mandates a lookup across editorTripData but never tells dev to expand the merge function's signature to include it, so dev will ship same-day-only lookup and miss the spec. Two more are escape hatches that would let the same pixel-layer bug pass QA again: (d) AC8 accepts both 'fix works' AND 'stale source card visible' as pass conditions; (e) S1 is Should-Have so text-fallback locators can false-pass on alternatives or source cards. The ticket must return to BA for a focused revision before dev can start.

Furthermore, _isCompatible at react_template.tpl:1977-1981 rejects non-meal cross-slot drops, so any activity-to-different-activity drop is REJECTED regardless of option existence. The 'fallback' clause ('dev MUST instead exercise a day where accommodation has multiple options with distinct images') is unsatisfiable. Codex's PROPOSED_FIX favors route-mocking; either is acceptable. The current 'skipped' fallback is not.

required_changes.concern: R1 says 'also search ... across editorTripData.days[*].slots[*].options[*] if the bridge has not yet copied it', but the merge function's call signature at react_template.tpl:2321-2324 is mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay(publishedDay, editorDay, editorSelections) — no editorTripData. The spec is asking dev to expand the merge signature AND wire editorTripData into the effectiveDay useMemo deps. Without explicit instruction, dev will implement same-day lookup only and ship a partial fix; cross-meal tap-flow + board-to-board paths where the bridge has not yet copied will silently fail.
required_changes.required_fix: Add to R1 explicitly: 'Dev MUST expand the merge function signature to mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay(publishedDay, editorDay, editorSelections, editorTripData) AND update the call site at react_template.tpl:2321-2324 AND add editorTripData to the useMemo dependency array. Lookup precedence: (1) editorDay.slots[slotId].options[*], (2) editorDay.slots[*].options[*] for cross-meal within day, (3) editorTripData.days[*].slots[*].options[*] across all days as last-resort lookup for when the bridge has not yet copied.' Update Technical Hints to reflect the new signature.

required_changes.concern: AC8 accepts BOTH 'S2 copies source slot to match' AND 'leave previous PLAN_DATA card visible' as pass conditions. The user's verbatim complaint is '拖了没反应' (drag has no reaction). Accepting 'previous PLAN_DATA card visible' on the source slot means accepting visible staleness — the same symptom the user is reporting. This is an escape hatch that would let dev pass AC8 while leaving the source-side of board-to-board still appearing broken.
required_changes.required_fix: Tighten AC8 to require: (1) target slot displays the dragged source content (mandatory primary assertion — this is the user's primary need); (2) source slot post-move presentation is documented as an out-of-scope follow-up cycle (deselect-UX); (3) stale source-card text MUST NOT be cited as evidence for AC8 pass. Per codex Gap 2 PROPOSED_FIX. The first assertion is the load-bearing one and cannot be conditional.

required_changes.concern: AC11 requires the data-drop-reject and data-drop-success attribute to be set 'within 50 ms' of the drop event. 50 ms is shorter than a single React commit on a slow CI machine (especially with the saveMutations chain). A genuinely working implementation could fail this AC purely on timing, especially because the success branch happens AFTER the setEditorSelection state propagates through useMemo re-renders.
required_changes.required_fix: Increase the attribute-set window from 50 ms to 200 ms (with expect.poll or rAF polling) for both reject and success. Keep the 600 ms removal window. Per codex Gap 3 PROPOSED_FIX.

required_changes.concern: S1 (data-slot-card / data-slot-id / data-option-id attributes) is listed as Should-Have. ACs use text-content fallback locators ('fallback to the dinner card under the meals Section'). Because day.meal_alternatives surfaces additional cards at L850-851 of react_template.tpl (containing the same text), and because the source slot card (which AC8 explicitly allows to keep stale text) may match by contains, text-fallback locators can false-pass without the target slot actually changing. The prior cycle already failed because verification was not pixel-layer-strict; this AC structure repeats the same vulnerability.
required_changes.required_fix: Promote S1 from Should to MUST. Make data-slot-card + data-slot-id presence on rendered Kanban meal cards AND Timeline entry wrappers a binding requirement. Reword AC1/AC2/AC3 locators to use ONLY [data-slot-card][data-slot-id='X'] — no text-fallback. ACs MUST FAIL if the attributes are absent. Per codex additional gap 3.

required_changes.concern: AC1/AC2 quote shortened names ('Yunxian Lou Cross-Bridge Noodles', 'Jianxinyuan Cross-Bridge Noodles', 'Chenxi Tofu Rice Noodles'). The real option name field values are longer ('Yunxian Lou Cross-Bridge Noodles (Historic Baoshan Street)', etc). The visible card text at react_template.tpl:875-876 uses whitespace:nowrap + ellipsis, so the rendered DOM textContent will be the FULL long string, not the truncated visual. 'Contains' semantics work, but BA should pick a canonical robust substring and explicitly state textContent.includes(substring), not equality.
required_changes.required_fix: Rewrite AC1/AC2/AC3 (revised) assertions to use canonical-substring matching: e.g., AC1 textContent MUST include 'Jianxinyuan' AND MUST NOT include 'Yunxian Lou'. AC2 textContent MUST include 'Chenxi Tofu Rice Noodles' AND MUST NOT include 'Yunxian Lou'. The negative assertion is what proves replacement happened, not the positive one alone.

required_changes.concern: R2 (Sidebar ✓ tracks editor_selections) claims Meals AND Accommodation AND Activity, but AC5/AC6 only cover Meals. With Activity correctness untested, dev could ship a fix that only updates the Meals sidebar ✓ and leave Activity sidebar ✓ broken. Same for Accommodation.
required_changes.required_fix: Add AC5b (Activity sidebar ✓ tracks selection — use evening_activity-2-1/2-2 swap on Day 2) and AC5c (Accommodation sidebar ✓ tracks selection — use route-mocked 2-option fixture from RC-2 fallback). required_changes.concern: AC12 uses 'git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD'. If the cycle commits more than once (which is common: a fix commit + a test commit or a follow-up nit), HEAD~1 misses the earlier commit and may show no out-of-scope changes when there are. AC12 must diff against an explicit baseline.
required_changes.required_fix: Change to 'git diff --stat 9218b6bd..HEAD' (the pre-cycle SHA). Explicitly forbid diff against HEAD~1. Add the requirement: 'git status --porcelain must show no modifications outside the allowed-scope files before the final close commit'. Also widen AC7 backward-compat to assert text equivalence across ALL 9 Yunnan days (not just Day 2) so that R4 byte-identity is enforced project-wide. Per codex additional gap 5.

required_changes.concern: The phrasing 'byte-identical DOM' (Goal L15-17) and 'byte-identical' in R4 (L276-286) is incorrect — R3 will inject a new <style> node, and S1 will add data-* attributes. Both change DOM structure without changing visible content. The 'pixel diff < 1% RMSE' (L520) and 'textContent equivalence' (L516) are the correct semantics; 'byte-identical' must be reworded.
required_changes.required_fix: Replace 'byte-identical DOM' phrasing with: (a) 'visible slot-card textContent equivalence' (per data-slot-card locator), (b) 'same card count and ordering per slot type', (c) 'screenshot pixel diff < 1% RMSE', and explicitly state '<style> node injection and data-* attribute additions are expected and do not violate equivalence'. Per codex Gap 8 PROPOSED_FIX.

required_changes.concern: The ticket verifies that Timeline updates after a Kanban drop, but does not require dropping ONTO a Timeline entry. Timeline entries at L1502-1538 currently have drag start + click but no drop target. The user's complaint 拖到 timeline 没有任何反映 literally translates to 'dragging to timeline has no response' — meaning the user expects Timeline to BE a drop target, not just a side-effect of Kanban drops. If dev only ensures Timeline reads from effectiveDay, drag-onto-Timeline still does nothing.
required_changes.required_fix: Add AC13: a Playwright drag chain dispatched onto a Timeline meal entry MUST land the drop with the same visual effect as the Kanban .slot-drop overlay. Either require Timeline entries to be drop targets (add .slot-drop overlays to Timeline at L1502-1538), OR explicitly document Timeline-as-drop-target as out-of-scope and capture in out_of_scope_observations with rationale. The current ticket is silent on this and may leave the user's complaint unresolved. Per codex additional gap 2.

advisories.note: BA's context.codex_consult block reports invoked=true, status=ok, 12 findings classified. Independent codex re-consultation by QA returned 8 confirmations + 5 additional gaps not in BA's original 12. BA's codex round 1 was thorough but did not stress-test the test data (AC3/AC9 fixture issues), the test infrastructure (S1 must vs should, AC12 baseline isolation), or the merge signature (R1 fallback across editorTripData). These are common audit blind spots.

AC7 is correctly scoped to byte-identity for default render, but the ticket does not require running the same equivalence check across the other 9 trip data folders in data/. R5 covers them via git diff, but a runtime equivalence check (load each non-Yunnan trip in the editor and verify zero visual regressions) would be the strongest form of backward-compat verification. Recommend BA add this as Could-Have or as an explicit out_of_scope_observations entry.
BA correctly defers deselect-UX (explicit-null) to a future cycle. AC8 RC-4 ensures this deferral does not weaken the AC. Acceptable.

BA defers per-category budget recompute. This is reasonable for THIS cycle since Donut and category rows are derived from day.budget computed at page-load. Acceptable, but should be flagged: if dev's R1 changes affect day.meals[].cost values, the donut/categories may visually mismatch the rendered slot cards. Recommend adding an AC that asserts the day-total chip (which IS recomputed at L1389) updates within 300 ms of drop; this provides a sanity check that recomputeBudget is firing without expanding scope into category-level accuracy.

If BA chooses RC-2 option (b) — seeding a second accommodation option with cover_image into Day 1 — this is well within R5 (Yunnan trip is the only data that may be modified). This is the cleanest fix. Route-mocking adds test infrastructure complexity but does not modify production data.
